{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Count how many rows were excluded due to -999
excluded_count = len(df) - len(df_clean)

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count how many patients remain after deduplication
patient_count = len(df_dedup)

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline (already in ng/mL)
mean_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print all required values
print(f"excluded_count: {excluded_count}")
print(f"patient_count: {patient_count}")
print(f"mean_baseline: {mean_baseline}")"}
